post.title: Travel insurance pays back about 40¢ per dollar. Here's why
post.ig:
Regulators found travel insurance pays back about 40 cents per premium dollar.
Europe's regulator EIOPA found a 40% average claims ratio and 24% average commission (2019 review). UK FCA data: claims were 31-37% of travel premiums in 2024 and 44-48% in 2025.
Americans spent $5.56 billion on travel insurance in 2024 (UStiA), and policies usually cost 5-10% of the trip (NAIC).
Our math: a $3,000 trip at 8% = $240 premium; at Europe's averages, about $96 to claims, $57.60 to the seller, $86.40 to the insurer.
Sources: EIOPA (2019), FCA value measures (2025 data), UStiA market study (June 2025), NAIC.
News and education, not financial advice.
